data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fara'ahah', meaning 'gift' or 'reward'. In Islamic tradition, Faryat represents the blessings and rewards bestowed upon the believers in this life and the hereafter. The name Faryat carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faryat usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faryat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
